title: Default value
prompt: solve takes n and step. step has a default value of 1, so the tests sometimes call solve with only one argument. Return n + step.
signature: func solve(n: int, step: int = 1) -> int:
starter:
func solve(n: int, step: int = 1) -> int:
	return n
hint: The `= 1` in the signature is the default. Inside the function, step is just a normal variable.
solution:
func solve(n: int, step: int = 1) -> int:
	return n + step
